decision.reason: The only change shown is that a deprecation log line ("...The --enable-composition-functions flag will be removed in a future release.") is no longer in cmd/crossplane/core/core.go in v2.0.0. Both excerpts [ev-2875a348b5d7] and [ev-59d22c21eec4] contain only "/*", so there is no flag definition to show whether the flag itself was removed, still exists, or is now ignored. Removing a log line doesn't prove the flag was removed, and the render validators were inconclusive. To decide the subject and change, we need the flag declarations (the struct tags or kong fields for --enable-composition-functions) in core.go for v1.20.1 and v2.0.0, or a release note saying the flag was removed.
